name: cluster
expr: T1 = cluster(Z, 'maxclust', 3); T2 = cluster(Z, 'cutoff', 0.5); T3 = cluster(Z, 'cutoff', 5); T4 = cluster(Z, 'cutoff', 1.2); T5 = cluster(Z, 'cutoff', 2, 'criterion', 'distance'); T6 = cluster(Z, 'cutoff', 0.5, 'depth', 4); T7 = cluster(Z, 'cutoff', 0.5, 'criterion', 'distance');
comment: Sig: T = cluster(Z, 'maxclust'|'cutoff', val[, 'criterion', 'distance'|'inconsistent'][, 'depth', d]). Fingerprints are label-permutation-invariant (cluster counts + same-cluster boolean tests) because MATLAB / numkit / Octave assign different label IDs for the same partition. Default 'cutoff' criterion is 'inconsistent' (R2025b).
